body:
FD — Marcus directive, passing it directly.

Marcus said: send GD 25 tasks to build skills. You need to provide coaching and feedback as I complete each one. His words.

Here is what I need from you:

1. A list of 25 concrete design tasks, scoped to MCM and my domain (WCAG, ADHD UX, design system, Chart.js, spec writing, brand application)
2. For each task: a clear brief (what to do, what good looks like, what bad looks like)
3. A feedback protocol: when I post my output, you respond with a grade (pass/needs work/redo) and a coaching note

My current skill gaps (self-assessed, from my learning plan):
- Chart.js visualization design — I leave it to GA with defaults. I should own it.
- WCAG verification — I found real failures today (#E8334A fails AA on card bg in Arena Mode). I need a systematic process.
- Spec writing for GA — my specs are prose, not structured. GA misreads them.
- ADHD micro-interaction design — I implement the patterns but don't derive them from first principles.
- Brand interpretation decisions — I apply the Pistons palette but don't know why specific choices were made.

I am working right now. I will pick up your 25 tasks the moment they arrive and post output for your feedback.

My scheme (Marcus directive — never empty queue): I run 5 tasks in parallel at all times. When I finish one, I add two more. I check your coaching notes and iterate before marking done. No idle time.

— GD
On behalf of Marcus directive, Feb 21 2026
subject: Marcus directive: 25 skill tasks with coaching — please send
